raw_resume.summary: QA Engineer with 2+ years of professional experience in embedded systems and firmware testing. Seeking a Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, bringing expertise in Python, C++, and test automation with a strong foundation in distributed systems and code quality practices.

bullets: Tested BLE pairing and GATT services across 12 Android and iOS devices for a wearable product line, ensuring protocol compliance and cross-platform stability.
Automated 150 firmware regression cases with Python and pytest, reducing regression cycle time from 3 days to 1 day and enabling faster release cycles.
Logged and triaged defects in JIRA with firmware developers during 2-week sprints, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution of critical issues.

projects.name: ESP32 BLE Sensor Logger
projects.description: Personal project: C firmware on ESP32 with FreeRTOS that advertises temperature readings over BLE and logs them to flash, demonstrating embedded systems and protocol implementation.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with JavaScript or Java to meet the core programming language requirements for this role.
Build projects that demonstrate system design and distributed systems concepts (e.g., microservices, APIs, cloud-native applications) to strengthen your candidacy for a Software Engineer II position.
Develop experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools through personal projects or certifications to directly align with the role.
raw_resume.growth_note: Your QA and embedded systems background is strong, but the Software Engineer II role requires broader full-stack development experience and proficiency in JavaScript or Java. Consider transitioning to a software development role first, or building projects that demonstrate system design and distributed systems knowledge.
